name: Pipedrive
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Pipedrive, manage contacts and deals through a visual pipeline with activities and reminders. The hard boundary is email sync, automations, marketplace, reporting, mobile apps, and sales workflow polish, plus integrations, data quality, and workflow lock-in.
